tools.name: harness_overview
tools.description: Map the filesystem task harness: top-level areas (human-controlled), how many tasks each holds and their statuses, any pending area proposals, and the shared materials folder. Call this first to orient before creating or updating tasks.

tools.name: list_task_folders
tools.description: List task folders as 'area/slug [status] (assignee) title', optionally filtered by area and/or status. Each task is a folder with its own task.md. (Filesystem harness; distinct from project_manager's JSON list_tasks.)

area.description: Limit to this top-level area name.

tools.name: read_task_folder
tools.description: Read one task's task.md (front matter + notes) and list the files in its folder (outputs/, notes/).

task.description: Task reference: 'area/slug' (preferred) or a bare 'slug' if unique.

tools.name: create_task_folder
tools.description: Create a new task folder inside an EXISTING top-level area (with task.md, outputs/, notes/). Fails if the area does not exist, because top-level areas are human-controlled — use propose_area for a new area. Set status=proposed to file the task as an AI suggestion awaiting the user's OK.

area.description: Existing top-level area to place the task under.

title.description: Task title; the folder slug is derived from it.

description.description: What the task is about (goes into task.md).

assignee.description: Who performs it. Defaults to ai.

assignee_name.description: Person's name for a human task, e.g. 山田さん.

due.description: Optional due date or due text.

status.description: Initial status. Defaults to todo. Use 'proposed' to suggest the task for the user's approval.

tools.name: update_task_folder
tools.description: Update a task folder's front matter: status, assignee, assignee_name, priority, due, tags (replaces), and materials_add (links a shared file). Bumps the updated timestamp. (Filesystem harness; distinct from project_manager's JSON update_task.)

assignee.description: New assignee. Setting ai clears assignee_name.

assignee_name.description: Person's name for a human task. Empty string clears it.

due.description: New due date/text. Empty string clears it.

tags.description: New full list of tags (replaces existing).

materials_add.description: Path of a shared material to link to this task (e.g. shared/templates/invoice.xlsx).

tools.name: add_task_note
tools.description: Append a timestamped progress note to a task's 進捗ログ section. Use it at milestones to record what was done and what's next; humans can read/edit the same file.

tools.name: propose_area
tools.description: Record a suggestion for a NEW top-level area in tasks/PROPOSALS.md WITHOUT creating the folder. Top-level structure is human-controlled; use this instead of creating an area when the existing ones don't fit, then tell the user.

reason.description: Why this area is worth adding.

tools.name: search_shared
tools.description: Autonomously search the shared materials folder for files relevant to a task, matching both filenames and text-file contents. Returns ranked paths with snippets. Use this to find common templates, references, and past materials before asking the user.

query.description: Keyword(s) to look for in filenames and text contents.

limit.description: Maximum number of hits to return (default 20).

tools.name: read_shared
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file from the shared materials folder by its path relative to the shared root. For .xlsx/.pptx/.docx use the dedicated Office skills instead.

path.description: File path relative to the shared materials root.
